watch.summary: A Rocket League player calmly approaches the ball only to immediately score an own goal and scream in laughter.

beats.what: The streamer calmly says 'okay' as he drives toward the ball.
He hits the ball directly into his own net.
An own goal is scored against his team.
He lets out a loud, high-pitched scream and laughs in disbelief.

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The instant contrast between his calm confidence and the immediate own goal creates a quick punchline. His vocal shock and laughter give the mistake a funny, lightweight landing.
